items.text: ETR weekend summary: McConkey GTD optimism/flak; Nacua GTD; Harvey not expected; Olave/Burrow/Black/McMillan expected (snap count); Flowers/Pittman OUT.
items.implication: Core Sunday AM reference for actives.

items.text: Broncos RB R.J. Harvey (hamstring), listed questionable vs Jaguars, is unlikely to play per source.
items.implication: Sit; look to handcuffs/backups for carries.
items.opportunity: Jonah Coleman/JK Dobbins role expansion snaps/carries.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) practiced Friday, improved more than anticipated; team did not elevate a WR and he is pushing to play with optimism he can go barring setback.
items.why: Practiced Friday after limited earlier; no WR elevation; Rapoport sources bullish.
items.implication: Project in with injury docks; monitor for flak jacket and official inactive ~90 min pre-kick.
items.opportunity: If out, Quentin Johnston and others gain targets/routes.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave, listed questionable (hamstring) for Sunday at Baltimore, is expected to play.
items.why: Schefter sources; Rapoport corroborates with Chase Young also expected.
items.implication: Start confidently; ETR/Levitan no real docks.

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring.
items.implication: Sit; Mark Andrews/others elevate in target share.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT for Sunday vs Patriots with foot injury.
items.opportunity: Germie Bernard or others for targets.

items.text: Projecting McConkey in with docks (status ~2:30 ET, RapSheet bullish); Nacua true GTD; Olave fine no docks; decent look Jonah Coleman (Harvey doubtful); Germie Bernard (Pittman out).
items.implication: DFS/season long adjustments for volume contingencies.
items.opportunity: Coleman/Bernard snaps if absences hold; McConkey routes if in.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Week 2 vs Bengals; not serious but misses at least this game (possibly Week 3).
items.why: Ruled out after limited/no practice; Grade 1 but caution.
items.implication: Sit; Dalton Schultz and secondary WRs rise in volume.

items.text: Rams consider WR Puka Nacua (hip), listed questionable for MNF vs Giants, a pre-game decision.
items.why: No practice Fri/Sat; true GTD per sources.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; if out expect TE bump and secondary WRs.
items.opportunity: If active full role; if out Davante Adams/others + TEs rise.

items.text: Bengals elevated QB Josh Johnson with Joe Burrow questionable (back) but expected to play.
items.why: Elevation precautionary; Burrow comments and sources positive.

items.text: Raiders elevated TE Chris Myarick with Brock Bowers doubtful (knee); practiced Friday but status uncertain.
items.implication: High risk sit or GTD monitor; Mayer beneficiary if out.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer TE volume if inactive.

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne: reduced Week 1 workload concerning; Alvin Kamara expected back creates squeeze/committee with Miller.
Loves Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches, 74% snaps, 40% route targets (team lead); Indy allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
Loves Ashton Jeanty: 99 utilization score (2nd among RBs), 19% target share recently; road at Chargers soft.
Loves Bucky Irving: high utilization, 26% target share, 100% RB RZ touches near goal line; great matchup.
Loves Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; strong career avg with Wentz; Bears soft vs WRs.
Loves Dak Prescott vs WAS: home smash, high implied total, WAS allowed big YPC/TDs Week 1.
